function.name: report_safety_emergency
function.description: FIRST action, even mid-booking, when the caller reports a CURRENT gas smell, a carbon monoxide (CO) alarm that is sounding or went off recently (even if it has stopped), smoke or a burning smell from the system, or electrical sparking. Calling it immediately speaks a fixed evacuation and 911 message while the emergency is recorded, so do not repeat that message yourself and do not call update_intake first or ask any administrative question. Send only hazard and caller_quote. Not for hypothetical questions. This records the emergency and pages the dispatcher; it does not contact 911 or send anyone.

hazard.description: gas_smell: smells gas/rotten eggs. carbon_monoxide_alarm: CO detector sounding or sounded recently. smoke_or_burning_smell: smoke or burning smell from furnace/AC/vents. electrical_sparking: sparks, arcing or melting wires at the equipment.

caller_quote.description: Short verbatim caller quote reporting the hazard.

contents.text: Please get everyone out of the home now, and call nine one one once you're outside. Don't use light switches or appliances on your way out.
Por favor, salgan todos de la casa ahora y llamen al nueve uno uno cuando estén afuera. No usen interruptores de luz ni aparatos al salir.
